compatibility_target: T2 unchanged existing executable; first smoke is an explicitly partial-offload workload

source.binary_source_binding: CMake cache points to this tree; executable has no embedded source identity. The runner verifies source HEAD and tracked cleanliness before a live session.

build_stack_caveat: CUDA objects were compiled by HPC SDK CUDA 12.9 while CMake FindCUDAToolkit and recorded link inputs resolve CUDA 12.0-era libraries. This is an unresolved runtime qualification item, not a compatibility verdict.
fixture_sha256: computed by runner from exact fixture bytes

runner_contract.default_build_and_ctest: CPU-only fixture, schema, oracle, and fake-server/process-lifetime checks
runner_contract.live_gpu_execution: Never registered with CTest. Root must invoke the finite matrix through the existing CUDA controller, after build and controller admission.
runner_contract.process_ownership: Each llama-server is a directly spawned child in a new session/process group; cleanup signals only that recorded owned group and records remaining group members.
runner_contract.artifacts: Per-control JSON result, stdout/stderr log, identity hashes, request/response, timing, process group, UUID-scoped nvidia-smi memory samples, cleanup receipt, and (pair facade only) validated V200_PROFILE_LOG owner-usage/budget JSONL plus its SHA-256.
runner_contract.preload_libraries: Repeat --preload-library in order: facade DSO, then root pair-initializer DSO for pair mode. One facade DSO remains supported for anchor diagnostics.
runner_contract.gpu_claim: Runner records application outcome; GPU_PASS requires the separate controller receipt and V200 allocation-owner evidence.
